children: Global and business leaders gathered in New Delhi for the Bloomberg New Economy Forum to discuss supply chains and investment plans amid geopolitical risks, Bloomberg reported. In a new book, former Canadian Deputy Prime Minister Chrystia Freeland and former Treasury Secretary Yellen say the US needs stronger economic ties with its allies.

The program also examined whether storage technologies could help battery factories built in anticipation of stronger EV adoption, and the greater effects of rising US inflation on farmers and the heartland.

title: Wall Street Week: US Alliance Ties, Battery Storage and Farmers’ Fed Warning
